what_was_done: The registered demo function is now measure(project, subject, run, *, wait=None, retry=''): the keyword arguments of the registry contract are taken and ignored (demo is direct, never a job). test_demo_is_direct no longer pins the absence of 'wait' in the signature; it calls registered_gate('demo')(root, STORY, run, wait=0, retry='x') and asserts a result with no pending state.

measure reads evidence_read(project, subject, 'demo', head) first and returns the passing record for the head unmeasured, so a later failing measurement (whose evidence_write would replace the record at the same name) can never overwrite it. The docstring now says so.

what_was_done: Every demo result is built by gatelib.result or gatelib.not_attempted; the hand-built _shape is gone. A failing table carries its failures into the result (error is the first line, the cap holds); the admission refusal is ok false with one 'admission refused' line, no doubled prefix; the evidence-write refusal is not_attempted at the head.

what_was_done: The demo gate reads the story's '### AC-<N>' headings. In table mode uncovered is the headings minus the criteria keys of the red record, and each uncovered criterion is a table row that does not fail. In recorded mode an AC-<k> file must name a criterion of the story, and a screenshot must be AC-<k>.png of one; any other .png and any criterion the story lacks is a failure line.

The cached green record is served only when green.<sha12>.xml still exists beside it: a lost report (a kill between the .json and .xml writes, a removed copy) is measured again instead of green passing forever at that head and demo failing on the missing copy.

The kept base report is written by rename (store.write_via_tmp) and read back through read_report; a kept report that does not parse is deleted and the base measured again — never read silently as an empty base set, which made every inherited test new.

The half rule counts only non-exempt red tests (red_non_exempt * 2 < non_exempt), while 'at least one red' still ranges over all new tests. One passing non-exempt test beside one failing wiring test now fails the red gate.

The contradictory 'Made exact' bullet of rewrite/spec/commands/gate-red.md is rewritten to match the quote above it and D10.

The re-freeze worker no longer crashes on either input: an <error> of no type is named 'build or harness error in <id>: unknown' (the guard _red already had), and the over-cap message counts len(record['tests']) instead of indexing metrics['new'], so D15's 'split the story' is given for a re-freeze too. The dead 'if record is None' branch is removed.

A cached green result without --since carries changed_files: [] as plan 3.1 promises (the list starts empty in _cached and is filled only by the --since branch). test_cached_green_rewrites_patch asserts it.

The whole base-to-head patch is written before the green record and its path stored in the record's diff_patch field (the evidence-record schema allows it), always base to head even after --since. test_since_patch_leaves_whole_patch asserts the record carries the whole patch.

measure passes the resolved head into not_attempted on the commands.test/test_report and --since refusals, so sha is '' only when the story could not be resolved. Asserted on the --since refusal and in a new test_report refusal.
The duplicated baseline failure block in the green path is gone; a failing green with a baseline named carries the line exactly once.
